title: It is my new favorite. Works great for meat searing and bacon crisping
text: It is my new favorite. Works great for meat searing and bacon crisping. I rented a house and it had one of these grill pans.  It is my new favorite.  Works great for meat searing and bacon crisping.  I would NOT recommend the 12" lid they "suggest" as an additional purchase... it doesn't fit.  But honestly, after thinking about it... I really don't use a lid with this pan.

product_metadata.title: Calphalon Ceramic Nonstick Round Grill Pan, 13", Black
features: Eco-friendly, PFOA-free ceramic nonstick cooking surface that easily releases food while you're cooking and afterward when you're cleaning up
Fast- and even-heating aluminum is hard-anodized for durability
Silicone grip handles provide a cool, sure grip, even when cookware is hot
Great for indoor grilling, the ridged surface gives foods grill marks and helps create authentic grilling flavor
Protected by a Full 10 Year Warranty
description: Featuring eco-friendly PFOA-free ceramic nonstick combined with Calphalon's hard-anodized aluminum construction, Simply Calphalon Hard Anodized Ceramic Nonstick cookware brings durability, easy food release and fast cleanup to your kitchen. The 13-in. Round Grill Pan is designed for quick and even heating, and the silicone handle feels comfortable and stays cool on the stovetop. Use this pan for stovetop grilling and searing - it's ideal for chicken breasts, hamburgers, sandwiches and vegetables. The ridged surface adds authentic grill marks and helps drain fat while you're cooking. Nonstick is PTFE-free. Oven safe to 400 degrees F. Hand wash. Cook on gas, electric, or ceramic stovetops. Covered by a Full 10 Year Warranty.
